identity.name: RANK1_BOOLEAN_SUM_IS_ONE_AUGMENTED_DETERMINANT_V0_7
identity.statement: For every square matrix M over a commutative field (indeed as a polynomial identity over a commutative ring) and compatible column vectors u,v, det(M)+det(M+u v^T) = det([[M,u],[-v^T,2]]).
proof: For invertible M, the block Schur complement gives det([[M,u],[-v^T,2]]) = det(M)*(2+v^T M^{-1}u).
The rank-one determinant lemma gives det(M+uv^T)=det(M)+v^T adj(M)u = det(M)*(1+v^T M^{-1}u).
Therefore the block determinant is det(M)+det(M+uv^T).
Both sides are polynomial expressions in the entries of M,u,v, so equality extends from invertible M to all M.

iterated_boolean_elimination.setup: Suppose D(x_1,...,x_n)=det(C + sum_i x_i u_i v_i^T), with each Boolean variable entering through one rank-one coefficient matrix.
iterated_boolean_elimination.closure: Eliminating x_i by D|_{x_i=0}+D|_{x_i=1} replaces the current matrix by one augmented row/column. Every other coefficient x_j u_j v_j^T embeds as blockdiag(u_j v_j^T,0), still rank one.
iterated_boolean_elimination.consequence: After n eliminations, a determinant of dimension dim(C)+n equals sum_{a in {0,1}^n} D(a). Construction is polynomial and does not enumerate assignments.
iterated_boolean_elimination.sat_implication_if_representation_existe: If arbitrary 3-CNF F admitted, in polynomial time and polynomial bitlength, such a rank-one determinantal representation with D(a)>=0 and D(a)>0 iff F(a)=1, then SAT would be in P; if D(a)=F(a) in {0,1}, the final determinant would equal #SAT(F).

relation_to_existing_e8_results.v0_4_obstruction: The explicit field-independent transversal/principal-minor support obstruction shows that the required universal rank-one SAT-support representation does NOT exist in the normalized rank-one model, so v0.7 is a positive elimination primitive, not a completed SAT algorithm.
relation_to_existing_e8_results.v0_6_fanout: Attempting to repair rank one by atomically selecting multirow Boolean bundles inside ordinary Cauchy-Binet is blocked by matroid basis exchange.
relation_to_existing_e8_results.new_design_question: Find a larger representation class than rank-one-per-variable that remains closed under exact Boolean elimination with only polynomial dimension growth.

next_target.name: E8_BOUNDED_RANK_BOOLEAN_ELIMINATION_CLOSURE_V0_8
next_target.question: For a rank-r update M -> M+UV^T with constant r>=2, can det(M)+det(M+UV^T) be represented by one augmented determinant using only one copy of M, with O(poly(r)) overhead, while preserving bounded rank of every untouched variable coefficient?
next_target.why_critical: A YES with overhead depending only on constant occurrence rank, together with a polynomial bounded-rank determinantal representation of bounded-occurrence 3-SAT, would create a genuine universal route. A construction that duplicates M on every elimination causes exponential blowup and is rejected.

scientific_ceiling.POSITIVE_RESULT: Exact one-determinant Boolean elimination is closed for rank-one variable updates with additive dimension growth.
